objective: Implement the smallest complete conservative recall-intake loop and validate it on fixtures and one live case.
actions: Implemented a dependency-free recall screening CLI with download/cache support
Added deterministic identifier ranking and four conservative outcomes
Added seven unit tests including ambiguity, no-clearance, and null-record regression cases
Ran a live CPSC corpus case and fixed the null-field crash it exposed
hypothesis: A small local tool can turn typed product identifiers and public CPSC data into a conservative evidence-linked intake action.
checks: Live 9,891-record corpus loaded after null normalization fix
Insignia NS-RGFGSS1 returned recall 26606, exact-model reason, official link, hazard, remedy, and hold action
limitations: Only one known positive live case was checked
Fixture tests do not measure population precision or recall
No manual-search timing or external user validation was performed
next: Evaluate held-out representative and adverse cases against a manual-search baseline and fix the most consequential demonstrated failure.
